source_brief.marketing_message: Stop overpaying commission on ETP trades. Get professional tools, transparent fees, and expert support. Start investing today.

plan.campaign_summary: Activate your trading potential with transparent fees and access to professional tools. Our emotionally resonant campaign connects with retail traders seeking clear, confident solutions and meaningful savings.

concepts.strategic_idea: Overturn the usual fee structures, letting traders focus solely on capturing opportunities.
